senses.gloss: m. (φαινόλης, φαιλόνης S. = pænula) a travelling cloak, pænula. Treat. Tsitsith (ed. Kirchh. p. 22) פילגס (corr. acc.; Sifré Deut. 234 תכלא; Yalk. ib. 933 תיכלא, prob. to be read: פִּינוּלָא).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 10:8:12">Y. Ned. X, end, 42ᵇ</cite> <he>מהו להתיר בפלונס</he> (not <he>ם …</he>) is it permitted to act as judge in absolving from vows wrapped in a pænula (in place of a Tallith)?; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:8:6">Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᵈ</cite> top <cite ref="Q01094"><he>פלנים</he></cite> (corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>פִּינוֹלִין</he>, <he>פִּילוֹנִין</he>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>מוכרי פילינין</he> Ar. (ed. Koh. <cite ref="Q00702"><he>פילינון</he></cite>, corr. acc.; ed. <he>מוכרי טהרות</he>) sellers of pænulæ; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:16">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אורגי פלגס</he> (corr. acc.) weavers of material for pænulæ.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 5:11">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 11</cite> <he>פמליאות</he>, <he>פימ׳</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:8">Kel. XXVIII, 8</cite> <cite ref="Q01139"><he>פמילאות</he></cite>) read: <he>פִּינוֹלָאוֹת</he>.
